about: Ground surface colours read from licensed photos, for mapped OSM areas whose tags do not give the colour. The geometry stays OSM's; only the paint colour changes. Colour = median of the surface's pixels on the photo (lit, JPEG): an estimate, not a measurement. The photo date is when it was true.

colours.what: multi-sport court at the north-west end of the Kolos stadium (OSM: leisure=pitch, sport=basketball, surface=paved)
colours.seen: red synthetic court; its inner playing area is green on the photos but is not mapped separately, so the whole OSM polygon gets the red

colours.what: running track ring of the Kolos stadium (OSM: leisure=track, sport=athletics; no surface, no width)
colours.seen: grey-brown unpaved ring around the pitch; the red synthetic straight along the stand is not mapped in OSM and is not drawn
